name: Shokushu ni Natte Shiro o Shuugeki Shi Onna no Ko o Haramaseru Game!! ~Shokushu 2~
original_name: 触手になって城を襲撃し女の子を孕ませるゲーム！！ ～蝕襲2～
source:
The long-awaited MATING SEASON is here!

Enticed by the scent of hormonal women
the tentacle monster has returned once again.

The hunting ground this year for newly estrum-wet ladies is the "Castle"

Wriggle your way through the gates
and spawn your seed inside the ready holes
of every woman in reach.

Impregnate! Multiply!
Create little squirming tentacle babies!

* Become the Tentacles is a direct character controllable 2D action game.

Break through the castle defenses.
Impregnate the womb of every woman to win!
Obliterate the annoying men who get in your way.

The Castle is a monster's paradise!
Let's turn it into one big happy family.

* Sequel to "Shokushu" with powered up everything!
Strike down free-moving enemies!
Wield magical powers and ring powers in battle.
All actions are controllable by keyboard.
translation:
期待已久的交配季到来了！

触手怪物被发情女人的荷尔蒙气味吸引，再次归来。

今年，新一批湿润的发情女性的猎场是“城堡”。

蠕动着穿过城门，把种子播进所有触手可及的女人那准备好的洞穴。

让她们怀孕！不断繁殖！
制造一群蠕动的触手宝宝！

*《成为触手》是一款可以直接操纵角色的2D动作游戏。

突破城堡防御。让每个女人的子宫怀孕即可获胜！
消灭挡路的讨厌男人。

城堡是怪物的天堂！
让我们把它变成一个幸福的大家庭。

*《触手》的续作，各方面都全面强化！
击倒自由行动的敌人！
在战斗中使用魔法力量和戒指力量。
所有动作都可通过键盘操纵。
